blocks.text: EL SEGUNDO, California — The Los Angeles Lakers waived guard Dalton Knecht on Monday in their final roster cutdown for the regular season. Knecht was the Lakers’ first-round pick in 2024, and he briefly appeared to be a star in the making early in his rookie season. The 2024 SEC Player of the Year at Tennessee scored 37 points while hitting nine 3-pointers against Utah in November of that year in the highlight of a nine-game stretch in which he averaged 18.9 points per game.
